claims.claim: Neatly used Disc of Hitman 2 PS4 available.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a PS4 game case cover titled “HITMAN 2” with PS4 branding.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: Witness report only covers the game case/cover; no disc condition, opening status, repair history, overheating, or ports are shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show any pads/inserts or a UK receipt.

risks.risk: Disc may be missing or not included (case shown, disc not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the disc itself (front/back) and/or a photo showing the disc inside the case.
risks.if_unproven: Price as case-only / disc not confirmed (worst case: not playable).

risks.risk: Disc condition may be poor (scratches, unreadable surface).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the disc surface under light (and a short clip of the PS4 reading/loading screen).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially scratched / untested (worst case: may not load).

risks.risk: Case completeness may be incomplete (missing manual/inserts/pads).
risks.proof: Photos of everything inside the case (manual/inserts) laid out, showing what’s included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete bundle (worst case: only cover case).

risks.proof: Photo of the disc label/region info and the back cover details (and confirmation it installs/plays on a PS4).
risks.if_unproven: Price as compatibility uncertain (worst case: may not install).

risks.risk: Cover/case may have hidden damage not visible in the single cover shot (cracks, bent plastic).
risks.proof: Photos of the case from multiple angles (spine, back, hinge area) showing any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly worn/damaged (worst case: reduced resale).

proof_requests: Show the disc (front and back) clearly, and confirm it is included in the case.
Provide close-up photos of the disc surface (under light) and a short clip of it being inserted and loading on a PS4.
Show what’s inside the case (manual/inserts/pads) laid out so nothing is missing.
Provide photos of the back cover/disc label for region/edition details.
response.reason: The witness can identify the item as a PS4 “Hitman 2” game case/cover, so it can be priced at its worst case. However, disc inclusion/condition and bundle completeness are not shown, so the price should assume the least favorable scenario until proof is provided.
